  • Constructor Details

    • Plane

      public Plane(Vehicle.MakeName initialMake, String initialModel, double initialPrice, int initialProductionYear, int numberOfPassengers) throws ValidationException.InvalidString, ValidationException.NullObject, ValidationException.NegativeDouble, ValidationException.InvalidDate, ValidationException.FullArray, ValidationException.NotEnough, ValidationException.NegativeInteger
      Construct a plane with necessary data. Number of engines will be numberOfPassengers divided by ENGINE_CAPACITY, and all engines will be set to OFF. Number of windows will be numberOfPassengers divided by WINDOW_GAP.
      Parameters:
      initialMake - MakeName Make.
      initialModel - String Model.
      initialPrice - double Price. Should be positive.
      initialProductionYear - int Production year. Should be positive.
      numberOfPassengers - int Array size for arrayOfPassengers. Should be positive.
      Throws:
      ValidationException.InvalidString - When initialModel's length is 0.
      ValidationException.NullObject - When make is null.
      ValidationException.NegativeDouble - When price is negative.
      ValidationException.InvalidDate - When production year is in the future or earlier that FIRST_VEHICLE_PATENT_YEAR due to obvious reason.
      ValidationException.FullArray - When there is already an arrayOfPassenger.
      ValidationException.NotEnough - When there are passengers inside the vehicle.
      ValidationException.NegativeInteger - When numberOfPassengers are negative.
